outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished 16:9 landscape location background for a cinematic semi-realistic Chinese visual novel, target 2048x1152.
Primary request: show the ENTRANCE EXTERIOR of the SAME modest Bijie neighborhood noodle shop in reference images 1 and 2, at blue-gray early evening with the sky still light. This is an adjacent camera view of the same place, not a different restaurant. Camera now stands several steps OUTSIDE on the damp pavement, looking diagonally into the open humble shop entrance. The threshold and the empty space immediately OUTSIDE the doorway are the main setting where three characters will talk, but render NO characters.
Input images: image 1 establishes the exact original shop identity and cinematic game-art style. Image 2 establishes the approved early-evening light for this shop. Image 3 is only a reference for everyday Bijie food-street architecture and red practical awnings; do not copy its people or words.
Continuity details visible through the entrance: large steaming stainless stockpot and hood on the left, blue-pattern ceramic bowls stacked on a practical metal counter, chili jars, worn wooden tables, teal and red plastic stools, a faded red canvas awning, simple warm hanging bulb. Exterior door jamb is worn wood with gray old wall; do not add ornate architecture. A plain practical umbrella stand or drip tray with a few closed umbrellas sits beside the doorway so arriving visitors can close umbrellas. A few water drops and wet paving convey recent rain.
Composition: open shop and defining details occupy left and middle, with a realistic near foreground patch of dry-ish threshold and wet sidewalk. Right third is calm empty street/pavement depth suitable for a standing character overlay. Do not put a major obstruction or eye-catching object in the right third. Modest view of sloped residential street, close-set old facades and practical overhead wires. Eye level, natural perspective, wide single scene, no split panel.
Lighting: overcast 6 pm dusk, blue-gray natural sky clearly visible, outside walls and pavement still readable by daylight, soft warm light from inside; must not be night-black or sunset-orange. Respect understated filmic warmth of the original.
Constraints: no humans, no faces, no silhouettes, no text, no numbers, no logos, no brands, no watermark, no UI. Any fascia is plain and unlettered. Cinematic semi-realistic environment illustration matching the original bg-street style, believable worn textures, not glossy CGI, not anime outlines, not a luxurious restaurant.

outputs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a single 16:9 landscape cinematic semi-realistic visual-novel background, target 2048x1152.
Primary request: create an AFTERNOON family wedding-meal variant of the SAME humble Bijie noodle shop in the references. This is a simple meal after a friend's wedding, held at their familiar neighborhood noodle shop, NOT a wedding ceremony and NOT a fancy wedding venue. The shop remains physically recognizable.
Input images: image 1 is the original night noodle shop and primary location/style reference; image 2 is its approved dusk version; image 3 is its entrance exterior for architectural continuity; image 4 is only local Bijie food-street material reference. Do not copy any people, readable lettering, brand marks or watermarks.
Preserve these invariants: small old street-side noodle shop with the steaming stainless stockpot and metal hood at left, stacks of blue-pattern bowls, chili jars, simple worn wooden tables, red/teal plastic stools, faded red canvas awning, practical exposed details, and a narrow view to the wet neighborhood slope. Keep it modest and lived-in. It is two years later but do not invent a renovation.
Required changes: natural AFTERNOON daylight fills the shop and illuminates outside walls and gray sky; weather is after rain and pavement remains slightly damp. No active heavy rain. Outdoor scene must read daylight, not dusk/night. The warm hanging bulb may be off or very subdued.
Set up 2-3 small simple dining tables left and middle with everyday home-style dishes: soup bowls, a few shared plates, cups and chopsticks. Add restrained red celebratory details: a small plain red paper garland or ribbon near the awning frame, a few short red ribbons, and one unlettered folded red invitation card on a left-middle table corner. No written glyphs or symbols. Do not use gold balloons, rose walls, satin-covered chairs, a stage, chandelier, arches, giant floral arrangements, luxury tableware or wedding dresses.
Composition: eye-level wide full scene; recognizable pot/counter/tables in left and center; leave the right third calm and visually quiet for a standing game character, with gentle street depth or a plain warm wall section. Table setting must not become a giant close-up foreground obstacle. Lower quarter simple for later dialogue overlay, do not render UI.
Style: match the original game's bg-street/background cinematic semi-realism, detailed authentic old metal/wood, light filmic texture, realistic perspective, subdued blue-gray daylight with small warm-red accents. Not anime outline, not glossy CGI, not a photograph copied from image 4.
Strict constraints: completely empty of people, faces, human silhouettes and mannequins. No text, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no borders, no collage. One fully finished location background.
